cards.title: Iran adds new demands as a temporary Hormuz route is discussed
cards.summary: AP reported that Iran has added conditions around reopening the Strait of Hormuz while Iran and Oman work on a temporary route; no signed operating agreement is public.
detail: Associated Press reported Sunday that Iran has made new demands around reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The same report says Iran and Oman are working toward a temporary arrangement in which ships would enter near Iran and exit near Oman, according to people briefed on the talks.

That is a narrower and more conditional prospect than a return to unrestricted passage. The strait is a major oil and gas chokepoint, so the practical test would be whether vessels can move predictably under published rules rather than whether negotiators describe the talks as close.

No signed text, joint announcement, or independently verified implementation schedule was available for this edition. The claims about the route and demands remain attributed to AP’s sources, and the U.S., Oman, and Gulf governments may describe the terms differently.
